crossRefs.note: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever.
All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever.
I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke…
Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

translations.web: Yahweh, your word is settled in heaven forever.
translations.bsb: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
translations.kjv: LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
translations.asv: For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.
